cels.v: 🕵️ ChaosEdgeSteg — hide a link inside a picture, then recover it. Upstream-compatible (a steg image made here decodes in the desktop CLI, and vice-versa).

metadata.name: B4
metadata.description: image A bytes as base64 — filled by the Decode pane's file input (fs.pickToCel)

cels.v: ② image from X / steg PNG (base64)

metadata.name: B5
metadata.description: image B bytes as base64 — filled by the Decode pane's file input (fs.pickToCel)

metadata.name: B6
metadata.description: EDIT ME — the shared password (upstream DEFAULT_KEY). The Decode pane's password field writes here.

metadata.name: B7
metadata.description: THE DECODE: tries A=cover/B=steg; on a bad-header/bad-password failure it swaps and tries B=cover/A=steg; returns the recovered text (or a readable 'bad password' message).

cels.v: ── EMBED (hide a link in a picture) ──

metadata.name: B10
metadata.description: EDIT ME — the plastron.ca #f= share link (or any text) to hide. The Embed pane's text field writes here.

metadata.name: B11
metadata.description: cover image bytes as base64 — filled by the Embed pane's file input (fs.pickToCel)

metadata.name: B12
metadata.description: reports the cover's dimensions and WARNS if the max dimension exceeds 680px (X re-compresses larger images to JPEG and destroys the hidden bits).

metadata.name: B13
metadata.description: THE ≤680 GUARD: a copy of the cover fit to a 680px max dimension (a no-op when it's already ≤680). Embedding always uses THIS, so an oversized cover can never produce an X-fragile steg.

metadata.name: B14
metadata.description: EDIT ME — the shared password. The Embed pane's password field writes here.

metadata.name: B15
metadata.description: THE EMBED: hides B10 (zip-wrapped in upstream's container) in the ≤680 cover B13 with password B14; returns the steg PNG as base64. Empty until a cover is picked.

metadata.name: A17
metadata.description: the 🔓 Decode view pane: two file uploads → B4/B5, password → B6, and B7 rendered as a clickable link when it's a URL.

cels.f:
=view('🔓 Decode',
	dom('div', style('padding', '.75rem', 'display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.55rem', 'max-width', '620px', 'font-family', 'system-ui, sans-serif'),
		dom('h2', style('margin', '0'), '🔓 Decode'),
		dom('div', style('color', '#666', 'font-size', '.9rem'),
			'Upload the ORIGINAL cover, the image you saved from X, and the password. The app tries both orderings; the recovered text appears below — as a clickable link when it is a URL.'),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), '① original cover PNG'),
			dom('input', attr('type', 'file'), attr('accept', 'image/png'), on('change', 'fs.pickToCel', 'chaosedgesteg.B4')),
			dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#2a8f56'), IF(B4 = '', '', '✓ cover loaded'))),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), '② image from X (steg)'),
			dom('input', attr('type', 'file'), attr('accept', 'image/png'), on('change', 'fs.pickToCel', 'chaosedgesteg.B5')),
			dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#2a8f56'), IF(B5 = '', '', '✓ steg image loaded'))),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), '③ password'),
			dom('input', attr('value', B6), style('padding', '.3rem'), on('input', 'param.set', 'chaosedgesteg.B6'))),
		dom('div', style('margin-top', '.5rem', 'padding', '.6rem', 'background', '#f4f4f7', 'border-radius', '.45rem'),
			IF(OR(B4 = '', B5 = ''),
				dom('span', style('color', '#999'), 'waiting for both images…'),
				IF(LEFT(B7, 4) = 'http',
					dom('div',
						dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#666', 'margin-bottom', '.2rem'), 'recovered link:'),
						dom('a', attr('href', B7), attr('target', '_blank'), style('word-break', 'break-all', 'color', '#2563eb'), B7)),
					dom('div',
						dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#666', 'margin-bottom', '.2rem'), 'recovered:'),
						dom('div', style('word-break', 'break-all'), B7)))))))

metadata.name: A18
metadata.description: the 🖼 Embed view pane: link → B10, cover upload → B11, size warning (B12), password → B14, and the steg PNG (B15) as a downloadable data-URL anchor.

cels.f:
=view('🖼 Embed',
	dom('div', style('padding', '.75rem', 'display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.55rem', 'max-width', '620px', 'font-family', 'system-ui, sans-serif'),
		dom('h2', style('margin', '0'), '🖼 Embed'),
		dom('div', style('color', '#666', 'font-size', '.9rem'),
			'Paste a link, pick a small cover PNG, set a password. Post the downloaded steg PNG to X as-is (no crop or filter). The cover is auto-fit to ≤680px — X re-compresses larger images and would destroy the hidden bits.'),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), 'link or text to hide'),
			dom('input', attr('value', B10), style('padding', '.3rem', 'width', '100%'), on('input', 'param.set', 'chaosedgesteg.B10'))),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), 'cover PNG'),
			dom('input', attr('type', 'file'), attr('accept', 'image/png'), on('change', 'fs.pickToCel', 'chaosedgesteg.B11')),
			dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#a66'), IF(B11 = '', '', B12))),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), 'password'),
			dom('input', attr('value', B14), style('padding', '.3rem'), on('input', 'param.set', 'chaosedgesteg.B14'))),
		dom('div', style('margin-top', '.5rem'),
			IF(B11 = '',
				dom('span', style('color', '#999'), 'pick a cover PNG to embed…'),
				IF(B15 = '',
					dom('span', style('color', '#999'), 'embedding… (the first run loads OpenCV — a few seconds)'),
					dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.45rem'),
						dom('a', attr('href', CONCAT('data:image/png;base64,', B15)), attr('download', 'plastron-steg.png'),
							style('display', 'inline-block', 'padding', '.45rem .8rem', 'background', '#2a8f56', 'color', '#fff', 'border-radius', '.4rem', 'text-decoration', 'none', 'width', 'fit-content', 'font-weight', '600'),
							'⬇ Download steg PNG'),
						IF(B13 = B11,
							dom('span', ''),
							dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#a60'),
								dom('div', 'Your cover was larger than 680px, so a ≤680px copy was used. Your friend needs THAT exact cover to decode — download it too:'),
								dom('a', attr('href', CONCAT('data:image/png;base64,', B13)), attr('download', 'plastron-cover-used.png'), style('color', '#2563eb'), '⬇ download the cover used')))))))))

cels.v: ▼ ChaosEdgeSteg algorithm — upstream henon.py + steg.py bodies (verbatim) + PNG/zip glue, ending in the `ces` op dispatcher. Edit A21 and the =def in A22 recompiles it live.

metadata.name: A21
metadata.description: THE ALGORITHM, on the surface (R10): the upstream Hénon map + edge-adaptive LSB steganography, verbatim, plus PNG↔BGR and the upstream zip container. Its `import cv2, numpy, PIL, mpmath` lines are visible here, so the py compiler auto-loads exactly those packages.

metadata.name: A22
metadata.description: THE BINDER (R10 binder idiom): compiles the Python source in A21 into the callable `chaosedgesteg.ces`, referenced by the decode/embed formulas. Editing A21 re-mints it.

manifests.name: chaosedgesteg
manifests.description: ChaosEdgeSteg — a sheetapp document that hides a plastron.ca #f= link inside a small PNG (edge-adaptive, Hénon-keyed LSB) and recovers it, byte-compatible with the upstream chaosedgesteg CLI. The algorithm is upstream Python running in a py cell (auto-loading numpy/opencv/pillow/mpmath); every decision — password, the ≤680px guard, the decode/embed compositions, the clickable-link result — is a positioned cell.
